title: PGA Tour Leaderboard Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration for the PGA Tour Leaderboard plugin

display_duration.description: How long to display the leaderboard (in seconds)

update_interval.description: How often to refresh data from ESPN (in seconds)

max_players.description: Maximum number of players to display

fallback_players.description: Number of players to show from previous tournament when no current tournament is available

tournament_date_range.description: Number of days to look ahead for tournaments (from today)

font_size.description: Font size for player names and scores

font_name.description: Font file to use (from assets/fonts directory)

highlight_color.description: RGB color for highlighting (e.g., leader or top 3)

vegas_mode.description: Override how this plugin appears in Vegas scroll mode. 'scroll' = individual player entries scroll through the stream (default), 'fixed' = entire display scrolls by as one block, 'static' = scroll pauses while plugin displays for its duration.

golf_game_mode.description: Golf Game Mode — manual Kalshi-favorites view on /v3/remote GOLF button

enabled.description: Enable the Golf Game Mode button path

update_interval.description: Accelerated ESPN+Kalshi refresh interval (seconds) while active

final_hold_duration.description: Seconds to hold final leaderboard after tournament ends before auto-exit

rotation_interval.description: Seconds to display each window of players before rotating to the next. Only active when rotation_views > 1.

rotation_views.description: Number of windows of top_n players to cycle through. 1 = no rotation, 3 = top-9 across 3 windows of 3.
